name: Exp_KalmanFilter
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the KalmanFilter custom indicator, which uses a Kalman filter algorithm to estimate price trends. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward trend and sell positions on downward trends, with configurable entry/exit switches and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. The strategy supports two signal modes: trend-based and Kalman-based, operating on a user-defined timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于KalmanFilter自定义指标的信号进行交易，利用卡尔曼滤波算法估计价格趋势。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的入场/出场开关和固定止损止盈。策略支持两种信号模式：趋势模式和卡尔曼模式，在用户定义的时间周期上运行。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于卡尔曼滤波器指标，卡尔曼滤波是一种递归最优估计算法，能够从含噪价格数据中提取趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为1时（上升趋势），若前一个值为0则触发买入信号；当值为0时（下降趋势），若前一个值为1则触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖独立的买卖平仓开关，分别在趋势反转时触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额、亏损后自由保证金及固定手数五种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA使用固定点数止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），止盈是止损的两倍，具有正期望比。策略还引入了新柱检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线上重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许用户选择回溯的信号柱位置。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Kalman Filter indicator, which uses a recursive optimal estimation algorithm to extract trend signals from noisy price data. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 equals 1 (uptrend) and the previous value was 0, a buy signal is triggered; when the value equals 0 (downtrend) and the previous value was 1, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions rely on independent buy/sell close switches that trigger position closure upon trend reversal. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. For money management, the EA uses fixed stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio with positive expectancy. The strategy also implements a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading on the same bar, and allows users to select the signal bar offset via the SignalBar parameter for backtesting flexibility.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，用于计算下单手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or fixed lot; negative for fixed lot

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/亏损后自由保证金/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: free margin/balance/post-loss balance/post-loss free margin/fixed lot

parameters.name: Kf
parameters.description: 卡尔曼滤波器的调节系数

parameters.name: Signalf
parameters.description: 信号模式：趋势模式或卡尔曼模式
parameters.description_en: Signal mode: trend or Kalman mode

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引

pros: 使用卡尔曼滤波算法，相比简单移动平均具有更优的噪声过滤能力和趋势跟踪性能
提供五种仓位计算模式和独立的买卖开关，给予交易者灵活的风险控制手段
2:1的止盈止损比具有正期望值，配合新柱检测机制避免过度交易
信号逻辑清晰，基于状态切换（0→1或1→0）产生信号，避免频繁震荡市中的假信号
pros_en: Kalman filter algorithm provides superior noise filtering and trend tracking compared to simple moving averages
Five position sizing modes and independent buy/sell switches offer flexible risk control for traders
2:1 take-profit to stop-loss ratio provides positive expectancy, combined with new bar detection to avoid overtrading
Clear signal logic based on state transitions (0→1 or 1→0) reduces false signals in choppy markets
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标KalmanFilter，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动时段可能止损过近、低波动时段止盈过远
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在点差较大的时段开仓可能导致不利成交
无移动止损或追踪止损机制，无法在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
未对持仓数量和同向重复开仓做显式检查，可能存在重复开仓风险
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator KalmanFilter; EA fails to run if the indicator file is missing
Fixed point-based stop-loss and take-profit do not adapt to market volatility changes, risking premature stops in volatile periods and distant targets in quiet periods
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits during trending moves
No explicit check for existing positions or duplicate same-direction orders, posing risk of repeated entries
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理自适应市场波动率
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在不利条件下开仓
增加移动止损功能，在趋势行情中逐步锁定利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to make risk management adaptive to market volatility
Implement spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to progressively lock in profits during trending markets

risk_points: 依赖外部指标文件，若缺失会导致初始化失败但不会造成资金损失
固定止损1000点在极端行情下可能不够，且无滑点保护上限
无同向重复开仓检查，可能在新柱信号持续时多次加仓
risk_points_en: Dependency on external indicator file causes initialization failure but no financial loss
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss may be insufficient during extreme market moves, with no slippage protection cap
No duplicate same-direction position check may lead to multiple entries when signal persists across bars
